I paid £50 at Pets at Home groomers and what I got back was shocking – my poor dog looked scorched! Like most dogs, he isn’t a fan of grooming, but instead of showing care and patience, the clearly untrained and uncaring staff couldn’t handle him. My dogs breed are profound to getting slighted matted and that could of been handled with common sense. Their “solution” was to return him to me in an awful state… and still charge the full £50.

I’ve since taken him to a proper, professional groomer who worked calmly and kindly with him, proving that a nervous dog can be groomed without trauma or butchery.

First - Pets at homes negligence.

Second - professional care and love.

I would strongly advise avoiding Pets at Home grooming unless your dog is a complete statue.
Friendly grooming staff, on time for appointments, good variety of products in store. Always treat my dog with care.

The shop is great, but the grooming salon is disappointing.
The listed price was £49 when I booked, and I paid a £15 deposit. However, when they confirmed my appointment, the staff told me the price was actually £65—a 33% increase. I wouldn’t have minded paying £65 if that had been clearly stated from the start.
Unfortunately, I only found out about the price change during the final confirmation, and the deposit is non-refundable. The staff explained over the phone that the website price wasn’t updated, which I find unacceptable—especially for a chain store.
It’s simply not fair to customers.

Today I went with my husband to Pets at Home Princess Alice and met amazing Wendy.
Wow.
We are worrying because our mother and son Cockapoos have managed sadly to get fleas.
We saw one small one almost 3 weeks ago and after putting the medication on their necks the next day the groomer saw they both had them and bathed them with flea shampoo.
They seemed OK  and we thought all was well but they are back now with them both scratching like crazy.
We went to the store and I asked Wendy for help. She must have spent maybe 15 minutes with us answering lots of questions we had.
She has now set us up to a monthly delivery and her knowledge I told her was better than Google!
3 years ago we had the mother infested after the receptionist had not contacted me to remind me to go and pick up the medication as she had promised and I overlooked it.
The vet jumped on the band wagon and charged me £80 extra too for a blood test to see if she had an allergy (as they do!)
Rolls eyes!
I can't speak highly enough about Wendy.
She is a font of knowledge.
She is a star.
Thank you so much.
We were really upset and happy now.
Dogs too are getting better and calmer as well.
Thank you.
